title: Growth Marketing Executive
description:
Growth Marketing Executive

Ashford, Kent - Hybrid

Up to £35,000
- Are you already working in marketing and ready to take on more ownership?
- Do you have some hands-on experience of campaigns, CRM, email marketing, content or lead generation and want to understand how all of those pieces work together?
- Looking for a role where you can bring your own ideas, experiment and see the commercial impact of the marketing you deliver?

We are recruiting for a Growth Marketing Executive to join an established international software business working with major newspaper and magazine publishers around the world.

This is a broad, hands-on role sitting closely alongside the sales team.

You won't be joining a large marketing department where you are responsible for one tiny piece of the puzzle. Instead, you will get involved across campaigns, content, lead generation, events, CRM and reporting, helping turn marketing activity into genuine sales opportunities.

You will work closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, who will set the overall growth strategy, but there will be plenty of scope for you to bring ideas, test different approaches and take ownership of delivery.

You will get involved in:
- Creating and delivering email, LinkedIn, paid and organic campaigns
- Building and segmenting target audiences
- Supporting outbound prospecting and lead generation
- Qualifying and managing marketing leads before passing opportunities to the sales team
- Creating content including blogs, case studies, whitepapers and sales collateral
- Supporting webinars, conferences and industry events
- Managing campaign and lead activity within the CRM
- Monitoring campaign performance and understanding what is generating engagement, leads and pipeline
- Supporting website and landing page activity
- Working closely with Business Development Managers to understand which campaigns and leads are converting
- Bringing forward new campaign ideas and testing different approaches

What we are looking for

You don't need to have done everything above already, but we are now looking for someone who has gained some commercial marketing experience and understands what it is like to deliver marketing activity within a real business.

You may currently be a Marketing Executive, Marketing Assistant, Digital Marketing Executive or similar and be ready for a broader role.

Ideally, you will have some experience across several of the following:
- Email marketing and campaigns
- CRM systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce
- Audience segmentation
- Social and LinkedIn marketing
- Content creation
- Campaign reporting and analytics
- Lead generation or working alongside a sales team
- Website or landing page management
- Events or webinars

B2 B, SaaS or technology experience would be useful but isn't essential.

More important is that you are commercially curious.

We want someone who doesn't simply ask "Did the campaign get engagement?" but also wants to know "Did it generate the right leads and what happened to them?"

You will need to be comfortable bringing ideas to the table, trying things, looking at the results and changing your approach when something isn't working.

This would suit somebody who has already built the foundations of their marketing career and is now looking for the opportunity to broaden their experience and become a much more commercially focused marketer.

title: Marketing Content Executive
company: Mission Aviation Fellowship UK - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing Content Executive

Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) is seeking a creative Marketing Content Executive to develop engaging, audience-focused content that supports our fundraising, supporter engagement and brand objectives.

This is a rewarding opportunity for a talented marketing copywriter to bring our mission and impact to life through powerful storytelling, creating content that inspires people to engage, give and advocate for our life-changing work.

Location: Folkestone, Kent (with hybrid working - two days a week in the office)

Rewards: Salary of £32,510.27, plus a generous pension scheme, annual leave entitlement, and other great benefits and professional growth opportunities

Contract: Permanent, full-time

The Role

As a Marketing Content Executive, you will create engaging, audience-focused content that supports our fundraising, supporter engagement and brand objectives across digital and offline channels.

Specifically, you will write, edit and adapt content for campaigns, supporter journeys, emails, web pages, social media and printed materials, ensuring communications are creative, consistent and tailored to different audiences.

Working closely with Marketing, Fundraising and Donor Experience colleagues, you will develop content for supporter journeys, appeals and stewardship, helping to increase engagement and donor income and strengthen supporter relationships.

Additionally, you will:
- Support case study development and story gathering
- Brief designers and videographers where required
- Set up campaign tracking and accurate tagging across channels
- Maintain marketing content and support our asset register
- Assist with supporter and fundraising events

About You

To be considered as a Marketing Content Executive, you will need:
- Proven marketing and fundraising copywriting and proofreading experience across web, email, social media and print
- Experience of collaborating across teams, such as Fundraising, Communications and Programmes
- Experience of working within an agile framework, including familiarity with scrum and sprint methodologies
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with technical expertise in marketing copywriting
- The ability to tailor messaging to different audiences
- Confidence using project management and content scheduling tools
- A degree or equivalent professional experience

About Us

Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) is a Christian organisation that uses light aircraft to deliver practical help, physical healing and spiritual hope to some of the world's most remote and inaccessible communities.

For 80 years, MAF has been working in partnership with hundreds of other organisations to enable access to medical care, education, livelihood training and long-term support in over 24 low-income countries.

They believe that every community, however remote, should have access to the essentials of life - that's why MAF's flights are a lifeline, not a luxury.

The Benefits
- Salary of £32,510.27 per annum
- Annual leave entitlement of 22 days per year plus 8 paid public holidays per year
- Non-contributory pension scheme (10% of salary); employees may make voluntary additional contributions
- Death in service payment
- Flexible working policy
- Access to our Employee Assistance Programme

This is an impactful opportunity for a marketing and fundraising copywriter with experience creating content across digital and offline channels to join our purpose-driven organisation.

You'll have the perfect platform to put your creativity and storytelling skills to powerful use, bringing incredible stories to life and creating content that inspires people to engage with, advocate for and support our work.

And, with the flexibility of our hybrid working model, you'll have greater control over your working week, giving you more freedom to balance your career with the people, passions and priorities that matter to you.

Christian Values, Beliefs and Ethos:

As a Christian mission, MAF UK seeks staff who share in the evangelical Christian values and beliefs as described in the mission, purpose, values, and beliefs statements. All staff will be required to actively support and demonstrate the Christian values of the organisation and to take part in organisational activities such as staff devotions, prayer meetings, and fellowship days.

Other organisations may call this role Content Executive, Marketing Executive, Content Marketing Executive, Marketing Communications Executive, Fundraising Content Executive, Digital Content Executive, Content & Campaigns Executive, Marketing Copywriter, Fundraising Copywriter, or Content Officer.

The closing date for this role is 7th October 2026.

So, if you want to join us as our Marketing Content Executive, please apply via the button shown. This vacancy is being advertised by Webrecruit. The services advertised by Webrecruit are those of an Employment Agency.Marketing Content Executive

title: Marketing Content Executive

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Are you an ambitious, hands-on Marketing Manager looking for the opportunity to build and shape a marketing function from the ground up?

As part of its next phase of growth, our client is looking to appoint an experienced Marketing Manager to establish, lead and deliver the company's marketing strategy. Working closely with the senior leadership team, as well as Sales, Design and Product Development, you will play a key role in strengthening the company's brand portfolio, driving customer engagement, supporting commercial growth and increasing brand awareness across both B2 B and consumer channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and implement the company's overall marketing strategy.
- Manage and develop the company's portfolio of brands.
- Plan, deliver and evaluate integrated marketing campaigns.
- Identify new market opportunities and support business growth initiatives.
- Manage and develop the company's websites and digital content.

- Work collaboratively with the Sales, Design and Product Development teams to support new product launches and customer presentations.

About You

You will be a commercially minded marketing professional who enjoys taking ownership and turning ideas into results. You will be equally comfortable developing strategy as you are delivering campaigns and creating engaging content.

To be successful in the role, you will ideally have:

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary of circa £50,000, depending on experience.

If you are looking for an opportunity where your ideas will be valued and your contribution will directly influence the continued success of a growing business, we would like to hear from you.

Apply now for a confidential discussion and further details.
